parsed.why: National seat under direct national rule; bathroom ban imposed by national legislature and protesters arrested, but no local ban or reporting form; July 2026 assessment lists it low-risk while warning of override.

Own 2024 bathroom ban covers government buildings and schools with a complaint/reporting form and documentary defence a visitor cannot meet; flag ban and care ban. Adds a hostile local layer below the national baseline.

Low-risk; 2013 gender-identity protections cover public accommodations; hate-crime enhancement; no bathroom ban. Weaker on documents (no X marker, medical affidavit required) and unresolved panic-defence bill.

Low-risk; public-accommodation protections since 2011/2017, constitutional equality amendment, X markers, care coverage and hate-crime law; assessment notes shortfalls in healthcare equity and incarcerated protections; facilities status unresolved.

Most-protective tier: public-accommodation ban since 2007, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, hate-crime and panic-defence repeal, and 2023–24 shield laws enforceable against out-of-state action — the strongest documented protective operating regime.
